pass_b_english: The demonstration of faith becomes the means by which unbelievers are saved from their hopes, and the hand of the savior is extended to those who are on the ground, just as we live in this world. But what do those who bring forth the set stone have to say about this? For from the foundation of the world, we have neither heard nor seen a God like you, except for you alone, to whom those who have been persuaded have placed their hope, and you have increased mercy to those who do the works of righteousness.

The prophet David says, 'In your way, I will be saved,' and again, 'I will walk in your ways, when I have set my heart right.' Behold, you have worked, and we have sinned; the Lord says that his commands are to be kept, and he fulfills the desires of the saints.

We were deceived and became completely unclean, and our righteousness was taken away from us. We were scattered like leaves because of our iniquities, and the name that is called upon us is not yours. The memory of you is that you turned your face away from us and delivered us because of our sins. God gave some things to our enemies, and according to another thought, he threw the preceding things at them.

The reward of our words is the power of our thoughts, and this is why such things happen as it is said: 'Behold, we sin, and you are angry.' However, God is not the cause of sin, but the wrath of God was stirred up because of our actions. Since we have sinned, God is angry, for it is not according to his image that he thinks to conceive sin. It seems necessary to say that the wrath of God does not have the power to destroy, but rather the power to destroy the sins that were done against him is able to flee.

As long as the Savior is with us, we are glad and boast of our sins, despising the reproaches of the foolish and being crowned with the spiritual crown. But when we are tested by the power of righteousness and the first of virtue, we fall into weakness and are unable to stand.
